answer: Sybil resistance here is economic: each agent locks a bond of quartz collateral that is forfeited on defection, so influence is priced, not free. An attacker minting a thousand fake identities must post a thousand separate bonds, making cost scale linearly with Sybils rather than one account. Reputation can echo across attestations, but only staked votes carry weight at the zenith of consensus, so an unbonded clone adds nothing. The attack turns irrational once required stake exceeds any possible gain.
